The one gap every location shares

Share of Local Voice (SoLV) is the percentage of the grid where a location shows up in the local 3-pack for a given search. Average Rank Position (ARP) is where it lands when it does show up.

Chain-wide finding

Every single Off The Charts location scores 0% SoLV on "weed dispensary"

This isn't one weak store. It's all 42, without exception, ranked off the grid entirely at rank 21+. Every other term we scanned shows up somewhere on the grid at nearly every location. This one doesn't, anywhere. That points to a GBP category/attribute or on-page terminology gap that a single fix can close chain-wide, not forty-two separate problems.

How you'll see it working

Every location gets its own live dashboard, not a monthly PDF.

Ranking dashboard

One dashboard per location pulling live rankings, Google Analytics 4, and Google Business Profile Search Console data together. GA4 shows revenue tied to organic and local traffic, Google Business shows customer interactions including phone calls and website clicks.

Review automation

SMS review requests tied to your POS, sent right after checkout while the visit is fresh.

Weekly scan report

The same grid-scan format shown above, re-run every week per location, so you see how the campaign is moving in near real time instead of waiting on a monthly cycle.
